Paperwork, reworked.

Edit, organize and sign PDFs locally in a focused desktop workspace.

## Highlights

- Direct text and image editing, page tools, review and local OCR.
- Signature Studio with varied lettering, personal marks and vector placement.
- Local recovery, recent documents, templates and keyboard commands.
- Hardened release packaging, updated PDF parser and retained third-party notices.

## Install

Download the Windows x64 Setup executable and run it. Windows 10/11 and WebView2 are required. The installer is unsigned and Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning.

## Privacy

Your documents stay yours. Core editing and OCR run locally. See docs/PRIVACY.md for local storage and platform-network details.

## Limitations

Complex fonts and scanned/flattened content may require substitution or OCR. Review saved documents before sharing. Drawn signatures are visual marks; certificate signing is a separate workflow. Only Windows x64 is distributed.

## Checksums

Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS.txt. The MPL source archive contains unmodified third-party sources required by their licenses; it is not an additional app installer.

Release maintainers: keep this draft private until final installer UI smoke tests, source/media privacy checks and binary scans are complete.
